summary: The three-file change meets the scoped in-memory reply-recovery contract by source review and 4/4 focused tests. The one volatile probe independently confirmed valid-body cap rejection retention, 0 new replies, memory_only storage, 0 account-receipt delta, same-thread rendered body and other-thread isolation. Its attempted correction phase is not evidence: synthetic setup replies were authored as review-fixture, but the probe tried deleting one as demo-teacher, so the slot was not freed. The focused regression test uses matching demo-teacher authorship and confirms explicit retry creates exactly one reply and clears the draft. No product defect found; preserve this probe qualification.

argv: --test-name-pattern=^(rejected teacher reply at aggregate capacity stays in its thread composer and explicit retry clears it|overlength rejected teacher reply retains one over the cap and cannot become valid through truncation|reply draft is thread-bound, teacher-only, and cleared on role exit or forum/app reset|successful logout clears a retained reply draft and leaving the thread clears it)$

evidence.correctionAttempt: not verified: the fixture authored setup replies with review-fixture, then attempted delete as demo-teacher; slotFreed=false and the retry remained capacity-rejected
evidence.lateSnapshotQualification: sameThreadAlias.route and explicitCorrection.replyDraftAfter were read at final JSON construction after changing to the other thread; do not interpret those fields as stage-time values. Stage-time rendered form snapshots are captured separately.

review.serviceAuthority: community.reply remains the unchanged teacher/thread/body/capacity validation, mutation, and persistence authority; the controller stores only semantic-failure draft data after that call.
review.boundedness: replyDraft content is capped at COMMUNITY_LIMITS.body + 1. Oversized padded content is trimmed only when raw length exceeds that bound, then bounded; 10,001 meaningful characters remain over limit on repeat rather than silently becoming a valid 10,000-character reply.
review.lifecycle: Draft is thread-keyed; renderer projects only when visible teacher role and thread ID match. Same-thread aliases retain; thread change, role exit, logout, forum reset, and app reset clear. Anonymous/moderator rejected content is not retained.
review.unchanged: app.mjs keystroke/FormData wiring, community.reply rules/limits/storage authority, and fixture-service ports are unchanged.
declined: No persistence across reload: this is a bounded, memory-only draft and forum storage remains authoritative for accepted forum data only.
No browser or production behavior claim: no browser, server, network, account, email, or production service was used.
No draft for an invalid thread/unknown error: only reply_required, input_too_long, and reply_limit_reached for teacher submissions are retained; other failures clear a matching stale draft.
